verdict.rationale: Temporal Cloud documents 'Service Accounts & API Keys' and 'User Roles' as pricing/security features (temporal-docs-20, temporal-docs-30), which could be used to scope credentials for an agent-driven Worker, and the platform explicitly targets AI agent workloads (temporal-docs-9, temporal-docs-25). However there is no documentation describing fine-grained/least-privilege scoping specifically for agent credentials, no RBAC granularity details, and no independent evidence of this being used for AI agent isolation. Missing for 10: granular least-privilege permission model documentation, agent-specific credential scoping guidance, and independent/hands-on confirmation.
